context.problem_statement: Given a clinical dataset with missing values, your task is to calculate the mean of the 'blood_pressure' column after imputing missing values using the KNN imputer method. This will help assess the impact of imputation on the dataset's central tendency.
context.expert_knowledge: Missing data imputation is crucial in clinical datasets as they often contain incomplete records. The MICE (Multiple Imputation by Chained Equations) and KNN (K-Nearest Neighbors) imputer methods are widely used. MICE models each feature with missing values as a function of other features, while KNN imputes based on the nearest neighbors.
